basic_genetics.name: Basic Genetics
basic_genetics.flavor_text: Every trait is a letter in a species autobiography.

ecosystem_observation.name: Ecosystem Observation
ecosystem_observation.flavor_text: You cannot shape what you cannot measure.

environmental_basics.name: Environmental Science
environmental_basics.description: Biome classification, climate fundamentals, resource flow.

advanced_genetics.name: Advanced Genetics
advanced_genetics.flavor_text: Form follows function, and function follows gene.
advanced_genetics.description: Deeper genome manipulation with behavioral genes.

behavioral_science.name: Behavioral Science
behavioral_science.flavor_text: Intelligence is natures most expensive gamble.
behavioral_science.description: Edit how creatures think, feel, and make decisions.

ecology_science.name: Ecological Systems
ecology_science.flavor_text: Every predator is ten thousand prey.
ecology_science.description: Advanced ecosystem modeling and food web visualization.

metabolic_science.name: Metabolic Science
metabolic_science.flavor_text: Life is just chemistry with opinions.

genetic_splicing.name: Genetic Splicing
genetic_splicing.flavor_text: Nature drew a line. We redrew it.
genetic_splicing.description: Combine traits from two different species.

neural_mapping.name: Neural Mapping
neural_mapping.flavor_text: The brain is just evolutions most complex organ so far.

climate_control.name: Climate Control
climate_control.flavor_text: Control the sky, control the world.

resource_engineering.name: Resource Engineering
resource_engineering.flavor_text: Abundance and scarcity are the sculptors tools.

disease_lab.name: Pathogen Laboratory
disease_lab.flavor_text: The invisible killer shapes evolution more than any predator.

terraforming.name: Terraforming
terraforming.flavor_text: The planet is clay. Become the sculptor.

genome_sequencing.name: Full Genome Sequencing
genome_sequencing.flavor_text: To read the genome is to read the autobiography of life.

ice_age_trigger.name: Cryogenic Control
ice_age_trigger.flavor_text: Ice ages do not kill. They filter.

ecosystem_prediction.flavor_text: The best intervention is planned three generations ahead.

synthetic_life.name: Synthetic Biology
synthetic_life.flavor_text: We are no longer observers. We are authors.

planet_architecture.name: Planet Architecture
planet_architecture.description: Full control over all biomes and climate.

genesis_protocol.name: Genesis Protocol
genesis_protocol.flavor_text: In the beginning there was nothing. Then a geneticist.
genesis_protocol.description: Seed a new world with all accumulated knowledge.
